held.why: held: S741's reason stands: page read 45953358884 shows the record read its page exactly ('Required Core: 30 units' over nine courses that add to 27, '6 units from:' and 'Total Units: 36'), and no filed kind names a list whose printed figure runs past its courses; the record also lists eight courses the state's file does not. claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
